messages.en: Don't worry about me. I'm home already.
I feel a bit better now. You weren't replying to my messages earlier, so I got worried.
Don't risk it. That road's already flooded.
All right, let's just take another route.
Has your cleaning robot finished cleaning the living room yet?
Yeah, it's moved on to the kitchen now. I just want to relax.

collocations.en: pray for the soul of the deceased

messages.en: I've prayed for Allah to have mercy on your late father's soul.
Amen, thank you. Your prayers mean so much to me.
